blocks.text: Carol Banawa expressed her gratitude for receiving a Most Outstanding Migrant Award as she responded to a netizen’s comment suggesting that others were more deserving of the recognition. The United States-based singer-nurse was earlier given the accolade at the 2026 Global Migrant Award Heritage People’s Ball.
